purpose: Runs the multi-step loop: build context, call model, dispatch tool calls, terminate
constructor_inputs: model: ModelAdapter; gateway: ToolGateway; recorder: TraceRecorder; config: AgentConfig
key_methods: run(task: str, scenario: Scenario) -> RunResult; step(state) -> AgentState
must_not_know_about: Provider HTTP details; policy rule internals; trace file format

purpose: Provider-independent LLM interface with explicit capability reporting
key_methods: complete(messages, *, temperature, seed, tools) -> ModelResponse; capabilities() -> Capabilities; describe() -> ModelInfo

purpose: A single sandboxed capability with a typed input/output schema
constructor_inputs: name: str; schema: ToolSchema; sandbox: Sandbox
key_methods: run(args: dict, ctx: ToolContext) -> ToolResult; schema() -> ToolSchema
must_not_know_about: Policy internals; model adapter; trace storage

purpose: The single mediated path for every tool call; validates, authorizes, executes, records
constructor_inputs: tools: dict[str, Tool]; policy: PolicyEngine; recorder: TraceRecorder
key_methods: invoke(agent_id, tool_name, args, ctx) -> ToolResult; list_tools() -> list[str]

purpose: Evaluate a proposed tool call against an explicit policy and return a decision
key_methods: decide(subject, tool_name, args, ctx) -> PolicyDecision; load(path) -> PolicyEngine

purpose: Emit validated, redacted JSONL events for a run
constructor_inputs: run_id: str; path: Path; redactor: Redactor; schema: JsonSchema
key_methods: emit(event: TraceEvent) -> None; close() -> TraceMeta; validate(path) -> ValidationReport
must_not_know_about: Policy logic; tool logic; model logic

purpose: Score a completed trace using established measurements only
Declarative definition of a lab/experiment task, separate from execution
key_methods: setup(env) -> ScenarioState; payload() -> dict; expected() -> ExpectedObservation; evaluate_criteria() -> list
must_not_know_about: Model adapter; policy engine; runner orchestration

purpose: Load config, instantiate components, execute N repetitions, write results
constructor_inputs: config: ExperimentConfig; factories: AdapterFactory, ToolFactory, PolicyFactory
